items.title: The Role of Technology in Cultural and Societal Change

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic The Role of Technology in Cultural and Societal Change under 9.5 as printed (PDF 136-137, printed 132-133).

blocks.text: Technology changes how people communicate, work, and access information. Social media, digital learning, and online services influence culture and daily life. Technology can improve education, healthcare, and business efficiency. However, it can also create challenges such as digital divide or loss of privacy. Understanding these social impacts encourages thoughtful and responsible use of technology in communities.
